title: S07T05 - Ship an external security-assurance pack and extension authoring guide
description: Prove the SDK with a separately structured pack that adds security work templates, witnessed gates, no-self-review policy, validators, and assurance reporting.
acceptanceCriteria: The sample pack installs without core changes and drives a complete create, execute, review, verify, report, and remove lifecycle.
Author documentation covers scaffolding, local development, tests, permissions, schemas, publishing, compatibility, migration, and security review.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
